address: 74 Soi Ban Huai Sai, Mu 4, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50200, Thailand
bio: With its simple, rustic look, this quaint eatery specialises in northern larb dishes, paired with a local chaeo dipping sauce with the aroma of toasted sticky rice. The spicy, sour and fragrant beef soup is a must....
